item.title: When Does a Woman Accept Shabbat?
item.description:
Does a woman accept Shabbat simply by lighting the candles? A Gaon says yes, most Rishonim disagree, and the Shulhan Arukh brings both views. The class explains the Sepharadi position, why it is still better to avoid work, and how a stipulation allows her to continue.
Daily Halacha — Shabbat Dayan Daniel Kada

item.title: Earliest and Latest Times to Accept Shabbat
item.description:
What are the earliest and latest moments to accept Shabbat? Plag HaMinhah in halachic hours, why lighting or Kiddush before it must be repeated, the calendar time compared with sunset, the two-minute minimum of Tosefet Shabbat, and what to do when that time arrives.

item.title: Lighting Shabbat Candles on Friday Evening Very Early
item.description:
A single person or a woman who must reach shul before Plag HaMinhah cannot light candles at the right time. Four options are set out: a Jewish agent, a non-Jewish agent, a timer on the lights, or lighting and accepting Shabbat early with a berakhah, relying on some poskim.
